description: This is a Java class defining a REST controller for account-related endpoints in a Spring Boot application, handling HTTP GET requests for bank and utility accounts.

classes.name: AccountController
classes.description: A REST controller class handling HTTP requests related to account information, utilizing Spring Boot annotations and Lombok for logging and constructor injection.

methods.name: getBankAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve bank account details based on account number.

methods.name: getUtilityAccount
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve utility account details based on provider name.
